## R97 Architecture Audit — Complete

All 13 reports written to `reviews/r97-audit/`. Synthesis complete.

### Confidence Matrix (sorted lowest-first)

| # | Component | Confidence | Verdict |
|---|-----------|-----------|---------|
| 11 | Observability | 72% | needs-fixes |
| 6 | Profiling + Extraction | 75% | needs-new-tool |
| 8 | Prompts + Persona | 78% | needs-fixes |
| 5 | RAG Pipeline | 82% | production-ready |
| 3 | Specialist Agents | 82% | production-ready* |
| 10 | CMS + SMS | 82% | production-ready* |
| 2 | Router + Dispatch | 85% | production-ready |
| 7 | Incentives + Crisis + Sentiment | 85% | needs-new-tool |
| 1 | Graph Architecture | 88% | production-ready |
| 9 | API Layer | 88% | production-ready |
| 12 | Config + Feature Flags | 90% | production-ready |
| 4 | Guardrails + Compliance | 92% | production-ready |

**Weighted avg: 83.6%** | **0 scaffolded modules** — all 66 files wired to production.

### Key Findings

1. **8 of 12 components production-ready**. 2 need fixes (observability, prompts). 2 need new tools (profiling, incentives).
2. **Phase 1 Pro switch: safe to proceed** with 1 blocker — `_select_model()` uses global flag, not per-casino. ~10 LOC fix enables canary rollout.
3. **H9(1.9), P9(2.1), H10(3.5) are missing business logic, not model capability**. Deterministic tools (CompStrategy, HandoffOrchestrator, LTV Nudge) will have more impact than prompt optimization.
4. **Rule 8 ("NO MOCK TESTING") is violated**: 55/104 test files use mocks (1694 occurrences). Only 16 tests call real LLM. Documentation should be updated.
5. **4 monolith files** need SRP extraction: nodes.py (1674), _base.py (1379), pipeline.py (1203), prompts.py (1052).
6. **SMS consent store is in-memory** — TCPA liability risk. Must persist to Firestore before enabling SMS outreach.

### Recommended Action Sequence

**Immediate**: Fix per-casino model routing flag (~10 LOC) + update Rule 8 docs.
**Phase 1 (Days 1-3)**: Pro switch with canary rollout.
**Phase 2 (Weeks 1-3)**: Build 4 structured tools (CompStrategy, HandoffOrchestrator, LTV Nudge, Rapport Ladder).
**Phase 2b**: Structural cleanup (extract monoliths, observability fixes, SMS consent persistence).
**Phase 3 (Weeks 4-8)**: Distillation (2K+ graded Pro conversations -> fine-tune Flash).

### Files Written
- `reviews/r97-audit/01-graph-architecture.md` through `reviews/r97-audit/13-test-reality-check.md`
- `reviews/r97-audit/synthesis.md` — full synthesis with tool specs and action plan
